_comment: Trust policy of the pilot deploy role (review E5-08). Created in AWS on 22 Nov 2026 from this file with <ACCOUNT_ID> filled in, and read back from IAM to confirm it matches (docs/release/04_SYDNEY_PILOT_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN.md section 4).

The default subject of a job that uses `environment: pilot` is repo:amolam/setuhaul-logistics:environment:pilot. It names no branch, so a role trusting it would accept a dispatch from any branch that reaches the environment. Do not use it alone.

Required GitHub setting (owner, repository level): OIDC subject claim customisation with include_claim_keys ["repo", "context", "ref"]. GitHub enforces its immutable subject format for this repository (owner and repository ids in the prefix; use_immutable_subject cannot be turned off), so the subject it issues is the second string below; the first is the plain form of the same identity. Both bind repository, environment and branch together.
StringEquals only: no StringLike and no wildcard on sub, so no other repository, environment or branch matches.
